commands: mountpoint /app && echo /app: MOUNTED || echo /app: NOT MOUNTED
mountpoint /data && echo /data: MOUNTED || echo /data: NOT MOUNTED
mount | grep -E 'efs|nfs4' || echo No EFS/NFS4 mounts found
env | grep EFS || echo No EFS environment variables
tail -100 /var/log/bootstrap-moodle.log 2>/dev/null || echo Bootstrap log not found
echo --- User Data Log last 50 lines ---
tail -50 /var/log/user-data.log 2>/dev/null || echo User data log not found
